title: Beatrix and the Compass
author: Zephyrine Eriksen
blurb: Emrys Brightwater, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
